body:
Every real bug so far was found via adb logcat; day-to-day use loses that lens.
Fit the self-hosted ethos: a default UncaughtExceptionHandler that appends crash
stacks to a small rotating file in app storage, plus a Settings entry "Share
logs" firing a share intent with that file. No telemetry service.
title: Android: capture crashes to a local log with a 'share logs' option in Settings
